args.command: env | grep -E '^(OPENCODE|AGENTSTACKS)' | sort > env.txt; command -v opencode > which.txt; opencode session export "$OPENCODE_SESSION_ID" > live.json 2> live.err; echo $? > live.rc; opencode session export --standalone "$OPENCODE_SESSION_ID" > live-sa.json 2> live-sa.err; echo $? > live-sa.rc; echo ok
